Class DefaultNitriteRepositoryOperations

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.runtime.operations.internal.AbstractRepositoryOperations
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.DefaultNitriteRepositoryOperations
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.context.ApplicationContextProvider, io.micronaut.core.convert.ConversionServiceProvider, NitriteRepositoryOperations, NitriteOperationsHelper, io.micronaut.data.operations.CriteriaRepositoryOperations, io.micronaut.data.operations.HintsCapableRepository, io.micronaut.data.operations.PrimaryRepositoryOperations, io.micronaut.data.operations.RepositoryOperations, io.micronaut.data.runtime.operations.internal.SyncCascadeOperations.SyncCascadeOperationsHelper<NitriteOperationContext>, io.micronaut.data.runtime.query.MethodContextAwareStoredQueryDecorator, io.micronaut.data.runtime.query.PreparedQueryDecorator
@Internal public final class DefaultNitriteRepositoryOperations extends io.micronaut.data.runtime.operations.internal.AbstractRepositoryOperations implements NitriteRepositoryOperations, io.micronaut.data.runtime.query.PreparedQueryDecorator, io.micronaut.data.runtime.query.MethodContextAwareStoredQueryDecorator, NitriteOperationsHelper, io.micronaut.data.runtime.operations.internal.SyncCascadeOperations.SyncCascadeOperationsHelper<NitriteOperationContext>, io.micronaut.data.operations.CriteriaRepositoryOperations
Default Nitrite repository operations. Implements core CRUD using Nitrite's Document codec.

This runtime executes the encoded query strings produced by the Nitrite query builder and by the document processor.

Supported query shapes

  • JSON filter (Nitrite criteria encoding), for example: {"title":{"$eq":"$mn_qp:0"}}
  • SQL-like SELECT/DELETE generated by micronaut-data-document-processor

Parameter binding

  • Criteria-generated JSON uses "$mn_qp:<index>" placeholders resolved from PreparedQuery.getParameterArray().
  • User-authored JSON @Query methods may use named placeholders like :title. These are bound using query bindings when available, otherwise by falling back to PreparedQuery.getArguments() names.

Update semantics

Nitrite updates are partial updates represented as a document of fields to change. Although the query builder and some JSON @Query methods use a Mongo-style "$set" wrapper, this runtime unwraps "$set" before calling collection.update(...). Passing a literal "$set" key to Nitrite would create a "$set" field on the stored document and would not update the intended properties.

Numeric equality

The mapping layer may store numbers as different Java numeric types (for example Long vs BigDecimal). Equality queries therefore tolerate numeric representation differences.

Since:
5.2.0
